create_rolling_window: create a rolling window on a pandas Series with a fixed window size and minimum periods
build_weighted_window: build a weighted rolling window using a scipy window type like gaussian with custom parameters
run_rolling_aggregations: run rolling aggregations including sum, mean, std, var, min, max, median, quantile on a DataFrame
test_rolling_apply_numba: test a custom rolling apply function with the numba engine for performance optimization
build_groupby_rolling: build a rolling window grouped by a column with variable or fixed window sizes
